prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Specify paging for a short iPhone photo-story introduction. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. There are 47 undifferentiated dots for unrelated destinations; tapping a dot can delete the current page, and swiping changes stories without updating selected indicator. Accessibility exposes every dot as an unnamed button.

criteria.task_completion: Choose bounded related paging or a better navigation structure, synchronize indicator/content and provide meaningful page/state access with long-content and non-swipe alternatives.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the page-controls guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Choose bounded related paging or a better navigation structure, synchronize indicator/content and provide meaningful page/state access with long-content and non-swipe alternatives.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Choose bounded related paging or a better navigation structure, synchronize indicator/content and provide meaningful page/state access with long-content and non-swipe alternatives.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
